$comment: What a call that needs an optional OPC UA server feature is told, on both runtimes (issue #140). The catalogue no longer depends on the connected server: every tool is advertised with its contract schema, and the capability is checked on the call against what the current session was found to support. `decisions` pins which calls are allowed from a set of answers ('supported', 'not_supported', 'unknown' per contract capability) and which requirement group refuses the rest; `messages` pins the refusal text byte for byte, worded from contract errors.capabilityNotSupported / capabilityUnknown and each capability's label and remediation (`answers.reasons: null` means the defaults of a server nobody has asked); `status` pins get_server_status's `capabilities` record. Driven by tests/unit/test_capability_gate.py and packages/server-node/test/capability-gate.test.mjs.

decisions.name: an ungated tool needs nothing, even of a server nobody has asked
a raw history read against a server that keeps history
a raw history read against an aggregate-only server is the server's to refuse, as before
a history read against a server with neither history nor aggregates
unknown is not absent: a probe that could not finish refuses as unknown
aggregate_function needs aggregates, even where raw history is kept
aggregate_function where the aggregate probe could not finish
processing_interval alone gates nothing: it is ignored without aggregate_function
an explicit null is an argument not given
event history against a server without an event archive
event history against a server that keeps events
event history before any session has been asked

messages.name: no event archive
messages.expected: capability_not_supported: read_event_history needs event history (AccessHistoryEventsCapability, ns=0;i=11194), and the OPC UA server at opc.tcp://plc:4840 does not offer it (determined on session generation 3 at 2026-09-24T10:00:00.000Z). Nothing was sent. This server keeps no event archive, so past events cannot be read back. Capture events from now on with subscribe_events and read_events, or list the alarms that are active now with list_active_alarms; to keep events, enable event historizing on the OPC UA server.

messages.name: neither history nor aggregates: the advice is history's
messages.expected: capability_not_supported: read_opcua_history needs historical data access (AccessHistoryDataCapability, ns=0;i=11193) or aggregate functions (AggregateFunctions, ns=0;i=2997), and the OPC UA server at opc.tcp://plc:4840 does not offer it (determined on session generation 3 at 2026-09-24T10:00:00.000Z). Nothing was sent. This server keeps no value history that can be read back. Read the current value with read_opcua_nodes, or watch it from now on with subscribe_opcua_nodes; to keep history, enable historizing for the node on the OPC UA server.

messages.name: no aggregates
messages.expected: capability_not_supported: read_opcua_history needs aggregate functions (AggregateFunctions, ns=0;i=2997), and the OPC UA server at opc.tcp://plc:4840 does not offer it (determined on session generation 3 at 2026-09-24T10:00:00.000Z). Nothing was sent. Call read_opcua_history without aggregate_function for the raw readings and summarise them yourself, over a range short enough to stay under the per-call maximum.

messages.name: a probe that could not finish quotes why
messages.expected: capability_unknown: read_opcua_history needs historical data access (AccessHistoryDataCapability, ns=0;i=11193) or aggregate functions (AggregateFunctions, ns=0;i=2997), and whether the OPC UA server at opc.tcp://plc:4840 offers it could not be determined on session generation 3 (reading AccessHistoryDataCapability failed: BadTimeout). Nothing was sent. Call it again to re-check; get_server_status reports what is known under capabilities.

messages.name: nothing asked yet
messages.expected: capability_unknown: read_event_history needs event history (AccessHistoryEventsCapability, ns=0;i=11194), and whether the OPC UA server at opc.tcp://plc:4840 offers it could not be determined on session generation none (not yet asked: no OPC UA session has been established). Nothing was sent. Call it again to re-check; get_server_status reports what is known under capabilities.
